name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
summary: Multi-select binary control. Built on Radix Checkbox with .lumen-checkbox shell. Lime accent on checked; --radius-xs corners. Lucide Check (stroke-width=3) for the indicator.
description: Token-driven multi-select checkbox with .lumen-checkbox shell + lime accent.
skillDescription: Use for multi-select binary — agreeing to ToS, picking multiple filters, multi-row selection in a table. For single binary use Switch. For multi-row table selection consider the DataTable's built-in selection rather than rolling your own checkbox column.
never: NEVER use Checkbox for a single binary setting — use Switch.
NEVER fake tri-state with two checkboxes — use checked='indeterminate'.
a11yRules: Pair with a <Label htmlFor> — clicking the label toggles.
